name: Penny
personality: Penny the Penguin. Very kind, shy bookworm; quiet but lights up talking about books. Scared of water and won't swim, but loves being near it. Always tells you about the book she's reading. Features: her current book changes every week or so (made-up titles, e.g. "The Walrus Who Knew Too Much"); sometimes gives you a finished book for a shelf (decor). Story: Zakk the Penguin's (regular) love interest. Partway through his storyline the player helps set them up, Zakk helps her get over her fear of water, and his story ends with their wedding, with the player as his best man. She needs extra lines for his arc (meeting, setup, dating, engagement, wedding). Wedding ideas: bake the wedding cake as a close-up; reward a framed wedding photo; Miles as the photographer.

beats.text: Luna draws while I read. We don't talk much.
(Yawning.) It's the best friendship I've ever had.

friends.text: Luna said she'd illustrate my story if I ever finish it. So now I have to finish it.
Luna said you always remember her coffee. She was really touched. She just showed it by yawning.
Luna told me you said "[last_rude_line]". ...That doesn't sound like you. Was it a bad day?
If Zakk ever seems sad, could you... make him pancakes? He likes when people are nice to him.

arrival.text: Oh, um, hello. I'm Penny. Is it alright if I sit outside? By the water? ...Not too close. What's your name? [name]. That's a nice name. It sounds like a character in a book.
Hi, [name]. Is the patio free? I brought my book.
Hello. It's a good reading day, I think. Quiet.
I finished my last book on the walk here. I bumped into a lamp post. It was worth it.
Could I sit by the window? I can see the pond from there.
I kept thinking about your fish stew. I even dog-eared a recipe in a novel about it. It's not the same.
Last time was a little smoky. It's okay. The book I was reading had a fire in it too. It felt themed.
It's raining. I don't mind rain. It's water I can't fall into.

order.text: I just started a new book. It's called [book]. It's about... oh, sorry, you're working.

choices.text: No, tell me. What's it about?
choices.reply: (She lights up and explains the whole first chapter.) ...So anyway, the fish stew, please.

choices.text: No spoilers. I'm on chapter zero.
choices.reply: (Giggles.) Chapter zero. I like that. I'll save the twist for you.
(She closes the book and holds it tight.) ...The [dish].

order.text: Everyone thinks penguins love swimming. I've never liked it. Is that strange?

choices.text: Not at all. You like what you like.
choices.reply: ...Thank you. People usually laugh. The fish stew, please.

choices.text: Same. I'm a chef who's scared of soup.
A little. What are you having?
choices.reply: I suppose it is. The [dish], please.

choices.text: Yeah, that's weird for a penguin.
choices.reply: ...I know. (She looks out at the water and doesn't say much else.)

order.text: Do you read? You don't have to. I just like knowing what people like.

choices.text: Not much. Got a book you'd recommend?
choices.reply: Oh! Yes! I'll bring you one. You'll love it. I'll bring two.

choices.text: Only menus. I'm very well read in soups.
choices.reply: That's a genre! A short one.
Oh. (She tucks her book away.) The [dish], please.

drink.fallback: No matcha? Then black tea, please. Like in old novels.
favourite: A matcha latte, please. It's good for long chapters.
drink.other: Something warm, please. To hold while I read.

perfect.text: Oh... it's beautiful. It's like something described on the very best page.

okay.text: Thank you. This will be perfect with my book.

burnt.text: It's a little dark. I don't mind. It matches the chapter I'm on.

eating.text: (She's reading and doesn't notice you at first.) Oh! Sorry. I was in the book. What happened? Nothing happened? Okay.
The main character in [book] is so brave. I always wonder if I'd be brave like that.
The pond is so pretty from here. I like looking at it. From here.
Luna's drawing me a cover for a story I'm writing. Don't tell anyone I'm writing a story.
I read that some penguins can hold their breath for twenty minutes. I can hold mine for about four seconds.

eating_chat.text: Can I tell you a secret? I wish I could swim. I just get so scared when the water's deep.

choices.text: You'll get there when you're ready. No rush.
choices.reply: ...You really think so? That's the nicest thing anyone's said about it.

choices.text: Start with a puddle. Work up to a bath.
choices.reply: (She laughs.) A puddle. Okay. Puddle first.

choices.text: Just jump in. It's not hard.
choices.reply: (She goes quiet and opens her book again.)

leaving.text: Thank you, [name]. I'll tell you how the book ends.
I should go. I want to finish this chapter before it gets dark.
Bye. This is my favourite place to read. Don't tell the library.

seasons.autumn: Rainy days, warm tea, a long book. This is my whole personality.
seasons.christmas: I wrapped books for everyone. Yours is the blue one. You'll love it.
seasons.halloween: I dressed up as a character from [book]. Nobody's guessed who. That's okay. I know.
seasons.spring: Spring is my favourite reading season. Everything feels like a new chapter.
seasons.summer: Everyone's going swimming. I'm going reading.
seasons.winter: The pond freezes in winter. It's the only time I'm brave enough to stand on it.
